primary_direction.title: Stage-Adaptive Proteostasis–Immune–Repair Platform
primary_direction.root_mechanism: Biomarker-defined disease state determines the order and intensity of proteostasis restoration, immune-state normalization, neuronal protection, and conditional cell repair.
primary_direction.intervention_type: stage-adaptive combination therapy and neural repair sequence
falsifiable_conditions: cell replacement only benefits permissive niches
primary_direction.feasibility: high for staged cellular and animal studies; moderate for clinical translation

competitive_directions.title: Mechanism-first repurposing screen
competitive_directions.reason: efficient candidate discovery but not a complete cure test

competitive_directions.title: Stem-cell neural repair
competitive_directions.reason: addresses lost function but depends on disease-environment control

competitive_directions.title: Broad neuroinflammation suppression
competitive_directions.reason: protective and maladaptive immune functions are not equivalent

rejected_directions.reason: does not cover disease-specific proteins, stage, or repair
unresolved pathology may damage grafts and integration

evolution_checkpoints.change: cure as binary outcome -> nested functional, biological remission, and repair endpoints
single mechanism -> disease-specific modules on shared systems backbone
cell replacement first -> pathology-controlled conditional repair
single biomarker -> composite state and held-out prediction
